Hi Ben — glad to hear from you. Sorry for the slight delay; AP was at month-end close. Answers inline below and summary at the end.

> Preferred supplier registration portal (Coupa link if applicable)
Please register via our Coupa supplier portal: https://supplier.coupa.com/register/ABCD-98765. Once you submit the supplier packet the Ops team approves within 1–3 business days if nothing else is required.

> Required fields to appear on invoices for automatic PO matching
We require the following for 3-way match automation:
- PO number (exact match) in the invoice header and in each relevant invoice line item when an invoice covers multiple POs
- Our internal project code (if provided on the PO) must appear as a separate field named "Radian Project"
- Tax ID (TIN/VAT) and full legal name of supplier
- Invoice date and unique invoice number

> Required tax evidence
- US vendors: W-9 completed; we accept DocuSign or PDF scan
- Non-US/EU vendors: VAT registration certificate or EORI as applicable

> Remit instructions
We prefer ACH for US payouts. For wire transfers we need SWIFT and intermediary bank details. Do not include account numbers in the initial Coupa upload — upload an attachment in the secure bank-details step, or we can accept a bank verification letter signed by your bank.

> Mandatory attachments
- Please upload a copy of the signed Master Services Agreement when completing the supplier packet.

Summary / next steps:
1) Register here: https://supplier.coupa.com/register/ABCD-98765
2) Upload vendor_form + signed MSA + W-9 (or VAT doc)
3) Email AP once uploaded so we can expedite approval and create the initial test PO (we'll send a test PO within 48 hours of approval).

I attached our supplier packet (radian_supplier_packet.pdf) that lists required metadata for invoices. Let me know if you want Kimberly or someone from redwood finance to join a quick screen share for the Coupa flow.

Best,
Elena Torres
Senior Supplier Onboarding Lead — Radian Energy
elena.torres@radian-energy.com
